Whole human race had fallen is a defensible idiomatic rendering of posteritatis genus omne successerat in this death context; heavenly one makes the substantival caelestis explicit without adding a new petition. The common ending is a new study rendering that naturally agrees with conventional older English, not an edited historical-English body or transfer of an excluded insert.

policy_basis.policy: guidance/liturgical-text-publication-policy.md sections1(6) and8.2; existing original study-English route
policy_basis.test: The controlling question is whether the later contribution, assessed as the whole resulting expression, supplies a protectable new authorship contribution; a numerical small-word ceiling or a closed list of substitution operations is not the rule.
policy_basis.strongest_counterargument: The low creativity threshold applies, and a modern liturgical editor deliberately selected an ancient prayer, changed words and endings, and placed it in a modern Good Friday ritual. Old ingredients alone would not clear a genuinely new arrangement. Relationship nouns can add meaning; an ending is not authorized merely because its opening cue was old.
policy_basis.resolution: Here each complete ordered petition and its distinctive theological content is independently printed in1894. The first loses one recipient pronoun. The second adds two conventional nouns that make existing personal and Pauline elliptical referents explicit, and substitutes an imperative synonym without changing the request. Neither imports a new petition, links disparate theological passages, or changes the inherited internal argument or word order. Each modern ending is itself a separately witnessed complete old common formula. Assessed jointly with that ordinary formula substitution, the later contribution in these exact two whole expressions does not reasonably appear to supply sufficient new expression to bar a clearly labelled fresh study translation. This is a qualified finite project judgment, not a blanket copyright clearance, holder permission, court conclusion, or authorization of the whole modern rite.
